verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, copilot, or agent for delegating tasks. The help-center excerpts cover only manual UI workflows for payroll, time off, onboarding and Xero mapping, and the probes show no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
